general.cardDescription: Port this panel listens on, and how it looks.
general.portHelp: Port used to access the panel (default: 3001).
general.restartRequiredDesc: Port changes require a restart. Save first, then restart.
general.restartToastDesc: Panel is restarting on port {{port}}. Reconnecting...
general.themeDesc: Choose between the gritty survival look or a clean light theme.

access.cardDesc: Controls which devices and browsers can connect to this panel. If you only access the panel from this machine, these defaults are fine.
access.quickStartTitle: Quick Start for VPS Remote Access
access.quickStart2: 2. Add one origin per line in the list below (example: http://YOUR_PUBLIC_IP:3001).
access.quickStart3: 3. Save settings, then click Reload CORS Rules.
access.allowLanDesc: Automatically allow connections from localhost and private/LAN IP ranges.
access.publicIpDesc: Look up this machine's public IP (via api.ipify.org) to display on the dashboard. Off by default — an unnecessary external dependency and small privacy leak for LAN-only setups. The result is cached, so this calls out at most once per restart.
access.lanAddressDesc: Which network interface's address the dashboard shows. Useful when this host has more than one, e.g. Tailscale and ZeroTier at once — pick the one you actually want to share with players.
access.diagnosticsRefreshFailedDesc: The numbers below are stale, not current.
access.additionalOriginsHelp: One address per line, including http:// or https:// and port if needed.
access.additionalOriginsTip: Browsers block a page from talking to an API at a different address than the one it was loaded from. If you open this panel from an address it doesn't already recognize — a domain name, a reverse proxy, a second network interface — add that exact address here or the browser will silently refuse its requests. Most single-machine setups never need this.

originsError.tooLong: Origin too long ({{length}} chars). Maximum is {{max}}.

access.allowAllDesc: Skip all origin checks — useful for diagnosing connection problems.
access.debugLoggingDesc: Log blocked connection attempts for troubleshooting.
access.securityWarningDesc: Allowing all origins removes browser-origin protection. Use this only for short troubleshooting windows.

updates.autoUpdateDesc: Check for a new release, download it, then apply on restart.
updates.stagedStillPresent: The downloaded file is still on disk; you can retry the restart.
updates.stagedGone: The staged binary is gone — re-download the update before retrying.
updates.avQuarantine: antivirus or Controlled Folder Access deleted the new binary after it was placed.
updates.avExclusionHint: Add this folder to your AV exclusions and retry:
updates.renameLocked: another process (OneDrive, AV, or a file watcher) held the exe locked. Pause OneDrive or close explorer windows pointing at the folder, then retry.
updates.permissionDenied: access denied writing to the panel folder. Relaunch the panel as Administrator or move it out of Program Files.
updates.helperBlocked: the update helper script was blocked from running (Windows Defender ASR, AppLocker, or Group Policy). The staged binary is still on disk.
updates.helperBlockedRecovery: close this panel and double-click Start.bat in:
updates.helperBlockedRecoveryNote: Start.bat picks the newest binary automatically, so the update will apply. To prevent this in the future, add the panel folder to AV exclusions.
updates.noHelperLogDesc: The helper script may have been blocked by execution policy or AV. Check Windows Defender protection history.
updates.confirmDockerDesc: The panel will save and stop Project Zomboid through RCON, then rebuild and recreate the all-in-one container. Players will be disconnected while the panel comes back online.
updates.confirmApplyIntro: The panel will exit immediately. A helper process will swap the executable and relaunch it in a few seconds.
updates.confirmApplyVersionSuffix: You are about to install v{{version}}.
updates.helperLogHint: If the new version does not come back online within a minute, check the helper log in %TEMP%(zomboid-panel-update-*.log) and relaunch the panel manually.
updates.footerSaveFirst: Save settings before applying an update.
updates.footerReady: Update files are ready. Restart to switch to the new version.
updates.footerDocker: Applying this update saves and stops Project Zomboid, then rebuilds and recreates the all-in-one container.
updates.footerDownloadThenRestart: Download the update, then restart to apply it.
updates.footerNoUpdate: No update is ready to install.
updates.footerDockerHandled: Docker updates are handled by the configured host controller.
updates.footerAutoUpdateDevMode: Auto-update works in packaged builds only. In dev mode, update from git.

https.cardDesc: Encrypt panel traffic with a TLS certificate.
https.recommended1: Enable HTTPS, leave certificate paths empty, save, then restart.
https.recommended2: The panel creates a local self-signed certificate automatically.
https.certPathHelp: Set both certificate and key paths, or leave both empty.
https.keyPathHelp: Supports PEM key files that Node.js can read.
https.provideBothDesc: Set both certificate and key paths, or clear both to use auto-generated certs.
https.autoGeneratedDesc: The panel will create and reuse a local self-signed certificate.
https.reverseProxyDesc: If TLS is terminated by Nginx, Caddy, or Cloudflare Tunnel, keep panel HTTPS off and proxy local HTTP.
https.restartRequiredDesc: HTTPS changes require restart. Save first, then restart from Panel Settings.

connection.cardDesc: Test the connection and set reconnect behavior. Host, port, and password are configured per-server on the Servers page.
connection.step3: Configure RCON host, port, and password there
connection.startupCardDesc: Whether the panel launches the game server for you.
connection.autoStartLabel: Start the game server when the panel starts
connection.autoStartDesc: Skipped automatically when the RCON port is already in use, so a server that is already running is never duplicated. Needs a local install path; servers hosted by a provider are started by the provider.

bridge.cardDesc: Connects this panel to the live game for weather, utilities, richer chat, and other in-world actions
bridge.dialogDesc: A Lua mod that runs inside Project Zomboid, giving this panel direct access to the live game world.
bridge.unlockChatDesc: Server chat, admin chat, world sounds
bridge.howItWorksDesc: Two pieces meet in the middle: the panel runs a file watcher, and PanelBridge.lua runs inside the game. They exchange commands via JSON files.
bridge.setupStep1Desc: Use the Install section on this tab to copy PanelBridge.lua into your server.
bridge.setupStep2Desc: Points the panel at the correct server data folder and starts the watcher.
bridge.setupStep3Desc: When the game loads the mod, status changes from Waiting to Connected.
bridge.requiresLuaChecksum: Requires DoLuaChecksum=false in your server INI. Commands can fail with checksum enabled.
bridge.advancedFeaturesNote: Advanced features on Events, Players, and Chat are now available.
bridge.remoteSetupDesc: This panel is running separately from your PZ server. Skip Auto Setup and the local bridge path above.
bridge.remoteStep1: Copy PanelBridge.lua into the remote server's Lua folder.
bridge.remoteStep2: Set DoLuaChecksum=false in the remote server INI.
bridge.remoteStep3: Enter the VPS path in SFTP PanelBridge files below.
bridge.remoteStep4: Click Verify and prepare SFTP, then Start SFTP bridge.
bridge.remoteStep5: Start or restart the PZ server.
bridge.remoteSetupNote: The SFTP bridge creates the remote bridge, inbox, and outbox folders automatically. The path must be on the VPS, not on this computer.
bridge.localStep3: Click Auto Setup to start the bridge watcher
bridge.localStep4: Start or restart the PZ server
bridge.manualPathHint: Or set the bridge path manually (Linux / VPS / custom installs):
bridge.waitingSftp: SFTP is ready, but the panel has not received a status file from the remote PZ server yet.
bridge.waitingLocal: The panel is ready. Start the PZ server with PanelBridge.lua installed and DoLuaChecksum=false set.
bridge.statusFetchFailedFallback: Couldn't reach the bridge status endpoint.
bridge.remoteConnectionDesc: PanelBridge and RCON are separate transports. Configure both for a remote server so every Events, Players, and bridge action has the path it needs.
bridge.rconCommandDesc: Used for console commands and RCON-backed event actions. It is stored with the active server profile, not with PanelBridge.
bridge.noActiveServerProfile: No active server profile is available.
bridge.sftpFilesDescRemote: For this remote server, enter the VPS folder here. The panel syncs only bridge status, commands, and results.
bridge.sftpFilesDescLocal: Syncs only the bridge status, command queue, and results folder. It does not read general server files.
bridge.setupOrderText: enter the VPS folder, click Verify and prepare SFTP to verify access and create the bridge queue folders, then click Start SFTP bridge. A missing status file means the PZ server has not written one yet.
bridge.sftpBridgeTip: Only needed when the dedicated server runs on a different machine than this panel. The panel connects here over SFTP to read and write that machine's config files. Get these details from whoever manages that machine — if your server runs on this same computer, leave this whole section blank.
bridge.remoteBridgeFolderLabel: Remote bridge folder on the VPS
bridge.remoteBridgeFolderHelp: Use the path as seen by this SFTP account. Do not enter a Windows path or a path from your local computer.
bridge.serverLogsNote: Server logs: read-only. The panel lists the remote log folder and fetches the tail of a file on demand. Nothing is written to the remote host and whole files are never mirrored to disk.
bridge.remoteConfigDesc: Absolute path to the Server folder on the remote host. Setting this unlocks the Server Config page for a remote server: the panel mirrors .ini and SandboxVars.lua over SFTP, edits the copy, then writes it back.
bridge.remoteLogsDesc: Absolute path to the Zomboid Logs folder on the remote host. Only .txt and .log files are listed.
bridge.selectFileHint: Select a file to load the last 256 KB.
bridge.autoUpdateDesc: When the panel starts, automatically copy the latest bundled PanelBridge.lua to the PZ server if versions differ.
bridge.serversLoadFailed: Couldn't load the server list — try reopening this page
bridge.remoteInstallWarning: Remote server: copy PanelBridge.lua to the remote Lua folder with SFTP or the provider file manager. Automatic local installation is unavailable.

mods.cardDesc: How often to check for Workshop updates and whether to auto-restart when updates arrive.
mods.checkIntervalHelp: Check every 1-120 minutes. Changes take effect as soon as you save.
mods.autoRestartDesc: Automatically restart the server when mod updates are detected
mods.restartDelayHelp: Players are warned before the restart happens.
mods.serverAutoUpdateDesc: Save, stop, update through SteamCMD, then start again when a new build is detected.
mods.steamAccountPlaceholder: Leave blank to use anonymous login
mods.steamAccountHelp: Use a Steam account that owns Project Zomboid when anonymous updates cannot access a depot. Only the account name is saved; SteamCMD keeps its own encrypted login session and may ask for Steam Guard again.
mods.warningMinutesHelp: Defaults to 15 minutes. Set 0 to update immediately when no players are online.
mods.apiKeysCardDesc: Keys used for Steam Workshop lookups and the server finder.
mods.steamApiKeyHelp: Used for Steam Workshop mod information and server finder features.
mods.howToGetKeyTitle: How to get a Steam API Key:
mods.howToGetKeyStep2: Log in with your Steam account
mods.howToGetKeyStep3: Enter a domain name (can be "localhost" for personal use)
mods.howToGetKeyStep4: Copy the key and paste it here

backups.cardDesc: Save and restore your server's world, map, and player data.
backups.scheduledDesc: Automatically backup your world on a schedule
backups.scheduleHelp: Default: every 6 hours. Uses cron format: minute hour day month weekday.
backups.scheduleTip: Each * means "any value". A couple of examples: "0 3 * * *" runs once a day at 3:00 AM; "0 */6 * * *" runs every 6 hours; "0 0 * * 0" runs once a week, at midnight on Sunday.
backups.maxBackupsHelp: The panel deletes the oldest backups when this limit is reached.
backups.loadFailedDescription: This isn't necessarily an empty list — the backup list request failed. Reopen this page to try again.
backups.statusLoadFailed: Couldn't check whether scheduled backups are on — this toggle is disabled until it loads. Reopen this page to try again.
backups.restoreTitle: Restore this backup (server must be stopped)
backups.restoreDialogIntro: This will restore {{name}} and OVERWRITE the current world data.
backups.restorePreBackup: A pre-restore backup will be created
backups.deleteDialogDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
backups.characterExportsCardDesc: Per-player character copies, saved separately from world backups.
backups.autoExportLabel: Export a character when a player joins
backups.autoExportDesc: Runs about ten seconds after the player loads, so one character can be restored without rolling back the world. Needs PanelBridge connected.
backups.copiesKeptHelp: Oldest exports are deleted once a player passes this count. Restore them from the Players page.

security.cardDesc: Change your password and review access details.
security.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
security.recoveryCodesDesc: Save these now while you can still sign in. If you forget the password, enter one on the login screen to set a new one. No server or file access needed.
security.regenerateReplacesNote: Generating new codes replaces every existing code.
security.copyCodesNowWarning: Copy these now. They are shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
security.recoveryTitle: Recovery when the current password is lost
security.recoveryLocalIntro: This panel session is running from the server itself, so you can reset the password here without typing the current one.
security.recoveryRemoteIntro1: The panel cannot show existing passwords. If you still have filesystem access to the panel host, sign out and either create data/reset-token.txt or start the panel with --reset-password.
security.recoveryRemoteIntro2: Once the token file exists, the login screen will show a recovery option so you can set a new admin password without knowing the old one.

regenerateJwt.cardDesc: Immediately signs out every user on every device, including you — access and refresh tokens for every current session stop working at once. Use this only if a backup containing the old signing key may have leaked; it is not a routine action and there is no automatic rotation.
regenerateJwt.confirmDesc: This signs out every user on every device right now, including your own session — you will need to log back in immediately afterward. This cannot be undone.
regenerateJwt.resultDescription: Every session has been signed out, including this one. Redirecting to sign-in…
regenerateJwt.failedFallback: The panel could not regenerate the JWT secret.

security.tipsRconDesc: Your RCON password is stored locally and is never transmitted outside of the RCON connection to your server.
security.tipsAdminDesc: Be careful with admin commands. Some actions like banning or kicking players cannot be easily undone.
security.tipsAuthDesc: Authentication is not configured. Create an account via the setup wizard on first launch to protect access to this panel.

about.elsewhereCardDesc: These features own their own configuration, so it lives with the feature instead of here.

elsewhereServers.label: Server profiles
elsewhereServers.detail: Install paths, RCON host and password, memory, and SteamCMD.

elsewhereDiscord.label: Discord bot
elsewhereDiscord.detail: Bot token, channels, event notifications, and the chat bridge.

elsewhereServerConfig.label: Game server config
elsewhereServerConfig.detail: Server INI options and sandbox rules.

elsewhereChat.label: Chat quick messages
elsewhereChat.detail: Preset messages shown above the chat input.

about.aboutCardDesc: Panel version, runtime info, and helpful links.
about.description: A web-based management panel for Project Zomboid dedicated servers. Includes RCON, player management, mod update detection, scheduled restarts, world backups, Discord integration, and the PanelBridge Lua mod for in-world actions.
about.supportDesc: Support development to keep updates and new features coming.
about.builtWith: Built with React, Node.js, and Socket.IO

corsLockoutDialog.title: Lock yourself out of the panel?
corsLockoutDialog.description: Disabling Allow Private/LAN Origins with no explicit origins listed and Allow All Origins off will block every browser connection — including the one you're using right now — after the next CORS reload.
corsLockoutDialog.recoveryHint: To recover, you would need to restart the panel with the CORS_ORIGINS environment variable set to a valid origin (e.g. CORS_ORIGINS=https://panel.example.com).
corsLockoutDialog.addOriginFirst: Add at least one origin in the box above first, then disable LAN access.

workshopSync.cardDesc: Mirror your tracked-mod list into a Steam Workshop collection so add/remove only happens in one place.
workshopSync.collectionIdHelp: Open your collection on Steam and copy the numeric ID from the URL (the digits after ?id=). You must own the collection.
workshopSync.autoSyncDesc: When you track or untrack a mod, the panel updates the collection in the background. Failures are logged but don't block your action.
workshopSync.autoSyncNeedsCookies: Auto-sync needs Steam session cookies below to actually push changes.
workshopSync.autoSyncNeedsCollectionId: Set a Collection ID first — nothing to sync to yet.
workshopSync.cookiesHelp: Required to write to the collection. Reading is free without these.
workshopSync.autoDetectDesc: Reads cookies directly from a browser installed on the panel host. Works for browsers logged into Steam on this machine. Close the browser first for best results.
workshopSync.chromeSealNote: Chrome 127+ may seal steamLoginSecure away from this method (App-Bound Encryption). Paste a Steam request if extraction returns nothing.
workshopSync.quickSetupTitle: Quick setup: paste a Steam request
workshopSync.quickSetupDesc: Steam marks steamLoginSecure as HttpOnly, so the cookies tab works but a one-click button can't read it. Easiest path: copy any logged-in Steam request and let us extract the cookies.
workshopSync.cookieExporterSuffix: (Chrome/Firefox, open source) works well on Steam. Open steamcommunity.com while signed in, click its icon, copy, and paste the result below — both its Netscape and Header String formats are understood.
workshopSync.pastePlaceholder: Paste a "Copy as cURL" command, a Cookie header, a cookies.txt export, or "sessionid=...; steamLoginSecure=..."
workshopSync.howToGetRequestSummary: How to get a Steam request to copy
workshopSync.howToStep1: Open steamcommunity.com in your browser, logged in.
workshopSync.howToStep3: Reload the page so requests show up.
workshopSync.howToStep5: Come back here and click Paste from clipboard.
workshopSync.howToManualAlt: Or, if you prefer the manual route: F12 → Application → Cookies → https://steamcommunity.com, copy sessionid and steamLoginSecure into the fields above directly.
workshopSync.cookieWarning: These cookies grant Steam login access — treat them like a password. Steam rotates the token every few weeks, so you'll need to re-paste when sync starts failing.
workshopSync.testConnectionTitleReady: Verify the collection is readable with these cookies
workshopSync.readOnlyTestNote: Read check only; write access is verified when an item is changed.
workshopSync.enterCollectionId: Enter a Collection ID to begin.
workshopSync.removeFromServerTitle: Remove this mod from the server configuration
workshopSync.addToServerTitle: Add this mod to the server configuration
workshopSync.untrackTitle: Untrack locally (panel stops watching this mod)
workshopSync.trackTitle: Track locally (panel will watch this mod for updates)
workshopSync.purgeTitle: Remove from the collection, the server, and disk, then ignore it so it can't come back
workshopSync.purgeDialogIntro: This removes the mod from all four places at once:
workshopSync.purgeDialogNote: It is then added to the ignore list so a later scan can't quietly bring it back. Restart the server to apply.
workshopSync.removeServerDialogTitle: Remove this mod from the server?
workshopSync.removeServerDialogDesc: This removes it from the server's active mod list. It stays tracked here and can be re-added at any time.

cookiesSaved.title: Cookies saved
cookiesSaved.description: Your Steam session is ready for collection sync.

toasts.noCookiesFound: No sessionid or steamLoginSecure found in pasted text
